incident.reason: the implementation built NASDAQ and VIX cumulative windows on an inner-joined calendar that dropped any US date missing either series; the resulting single-session extra residual was materially nonzero, so extra=cumulative-baseline mixed calendar/measurement mismatch with economic accumulation
retained_from_invalid_run: the discovery of the measurement mismatch

research_question: After constructing NASDAQ and VIX on independent source calendars, does replacing stale/one-day baseline US features with the exact information-window return since the previous China session improve next-session CSI1000 gap prediction?

data_boundary.us: existing repository NASDAQ/VIX parquet through 2020-12-31 only

measurement_contract.nasdaq_calendar: all dates with nonmissing NASDAQ level, independent of VIX missingness
measurement_contract.vix_calendar: all dates with nonmissing VIX level, independent of NASDAQ missingness
measurement_contract.last_daily_return: level[last session strictly before target China day] / level[previous available session] - 1
measurement_contract.window_return: level[last session strictly before target China day] / level[last session strictly before previous China day] - 1
measurement_contract.window_intervals: end_index - start_index on that series' own nonmissing calendar

interpretation.interval_0: no new foreign trading observation since previous China session; correct window return is 0
interpretation.interval_1: one new foreign session; window return equals the last daily return
interpretation.interval_ge_2: multiple foreign sessions accumulated while China was closed

measurement_contract.alignment_audit: compare reconstructed last_daily_return to panel us_nasdaq/us_vix_chg; report correlation, MAE and max absolute difference before interpreting model results

candidate_family.definition: replace baseline us_nasdaq and us_vix_chg with their separate-calendar window returns
replace only us_nasdaq with NASDAQ window return; keep baseline VIX feature
replace only us_vix_chg with VIX window return; keep baseline NASDAQ feature
for each US series use window return only when its own interval count >=2; otherwise retain baseline last-daily feature
for each US series set the baseline feature to zero only when its own interval count ==0; otherwise retain baseline feature
candidate_family.role: isolate stale-feature suppression when no new US observation arrived

candidate_family.definition: replace both US features by separate-calendar window returns only on existing holiday_reopen==1 days; otherwise retain baseline features
baseline plus exact copies of existing us_nasdaq and us_vix_chg
candidate_family.role: Ridge geometry placebo; zero new information

secondary_metrics: SSE improvement by ordinary/tail 30bp frozen ledger cut

decision_rules.measurement_fail_closed: if reconstructed last-daily feature does not closely track the panel feature, report measurement gap and do not interpret D1-D6 economically
decision_rules.primary_progression: only D1 above D0 can support corrected information-clock progression; D2-D6 are attribution diagnostics and cannot be promoted separately in this round
decision_rules.multi_session_mechanism: D4 above D0 supports multi-session accumulation specifically
decision_rules.stale_suppression_mechanism: D5 above D0 supports information-age correction when no new US session occurred
decision_rules.holiday_routing: D6 is diagnostic only and cannot create a holiday runtime rule from this consumed holdout
